subject: Benchmark report launch enablement kit (v1) — talk track + FAQ + deck
body:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jun 20, 2025 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Benchmark report launch enablement kit (v1) — talk track + FAQ + deck

Team — sharing the v1 enablement kit for the benchmark report launch so Sales/SE/CS are aligned on what we can/can’t say and how to handle methodology questions.

Folder (latest lives here):
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Q4yKpEnablementBenchmarkKit

What’s included (v1):
- One-pager (internal): who this is for, top insights, CTA paths (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
- FAQ + objection handling: fairness/methodology, variance, competitor comparisons (safe language)
- Internal deck: use for team readouts + how to demo the interactive page
- Message house: core narrative + disallowed phrasing

Asks for Sales Leadership by EOD Monday:
1) Region-specific talk track needs: do we want distinct US vs EMEA vs APAC callouts, or keep to one global script + small addendum?
2) Any “gotcha” objections you’re already hearing so we can pre-bake responses.
3) Confirm you’re comfortable with the default CTA sequencing:
   - PLG/prospects: “Try Hosted” (free credits)
   - Enterprise/reg: “Book a Dedicated sizing / Private consult”

Attachments:
- Redwood_Benchmark_Enablement_OnePager_v1.pdf
- Benchmark_Report_FAQ_Objections_v1.docx
- Benchmark_Launch_Internal_Deck_v1.pptx

Thanks —
Stephanie
Sales Enablement, NA
Redwood Inference


---
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jun 20, 2025 at 6:31 PM CET
Subject: Re: Benchmark report launch enablement kit (v1) — talk track + FAQ + deck

This is great, thank you.

EMEA request: can we add a short EMEA addendum (half-page) with:
- Which EU region(s) we’re explicitly publishing (so AEs don’t improvise)
- A single approved sentence on data residency (what we can claim today for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
- “If asked about EU latency numbers vs customer workload” script (people will challenge if their prompt mix differs)

We’re already getting:
- “Does latency/$ bake in caching? Are you turning knobs competitors don’t?”
- “If we run in eu-west, do we need Dedicated to get consistent p95?”

If you want, I’ll propose language but would like PMM/legal to bless it.

—
Lukas Meyer
Sales Enablement, EMEA


---
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jun 20, 2025 at 10:07 AM PT
Subject: Re: Benchmark report launch enablement kit (v1) — talk track + FAQ + deck

+1 on region addendum.

SE angle: we need a “replication / PoC” mini-talk track (60 seconds) for prospects who ask:
- Can we reproduce these numbers in our VPC?
- What exact workload assumptions are behind the charts?
- What do we tell them if their results differ (due to context length / concurrency / streaming)?

If we can point to a public methodology page + give a simple PoC template (“run 3 workloads, capture p50/p95 and $/1M tokens, compare apples-to-apples”), that will reduce back-and-forth.

Also: can we add one slide that cleanly distinguishes latency/$ vs raw tokens/sec and why we lead with latency/$?

—
Markus
Solutions Engineering


---
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jun 20, 2025 at 10:42 AM PT
Subject: Re: Benchmark report launch enablement kit (v1) — talk track + FAQ + deck

Yes to both requests.

Plan:
1) EMEA addendum: Lukas, please draft the exact sentences you want for data residency and which EU region to name. Camila + I will route to Legal for final wording.
2) Replication/PoC talk track: Markus, agreed. We’ll add a “How to replicate” section with:
   - 3 recommended test shapes (prefill-heavy, decode-heavy, mixed)
   - concurrency ranges
   - note on caching/batching being configured per methodology (and how to disable/adjust for a clean comparison)
   - variance guidance (“expect some noise; repeat runs; compare distributions not single numbers”)

Re: the caching question — we should be explicit: the report represents a production-representative configuration consistent across runs, and we publish the config and caveats. We do NOT want sellers saying “we enabled magical caching others don’t.” Instead: “We measured end-to-end serving economics with a stable, published configuration.”

I’ll also add a slide: “Latency/$ vs tokens/sec” (what each captures, why tokens/sec is insufficient for user-perceived latency and cost).

Linking the internal message house for quick reference:
https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/x/benchmark-message-house

—
Soojin
Director, Product Marketing


---
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jun 20, 2025 at 11:18 AM PT
Subject: Re: Benchmark report launch enablement kit (v1) — talk track + FAQ + deck

Two notes before this goes wider:

1) Comparative phrasing: please keep the talk track anchored on “measured on Redwood” and “workload-specific.” Avoid “fastest/cheapest” language unless it’s explicitly substantiated in the published materials and approved.

2) Region/data residency: we need one approved line per deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). EMEA addendum is the right place, but it must be consistent with our current commitments.

Otherwise looks solid. Thanks for tightening this up early — it will save us pain in launch week.

Camila
VP Marketing

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jun 20, 2025 at 12:03 PM PT
Subject: Re: Benchmark report launch enablement kit (v1) — talk track + FAQ + deck

Adding one Growth ask: if we’re doing region-specific addenda, please keep them as 1-page PDFs so we can attach them cleanly in the internal announcement + enablement email. Also, we’ll want a canonical “methodology summary” link that Sales can paste (vs sharing internal docs).

If helpful, I can provide the final UTM’d landing page link + tracking guidance once the page is in staging.

— Ben
Growth Marketing

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jun 20, 2025 at 3:48 PM PT
Subject: Re: Benchmark report launch enablement kit (v1) — talk track + FAQ + deck

Perfect.

Action items:
- Lukas: send draft EMEA addendum language (EU region naming + data residency sentence per deployment) by Tue 10am CET.
- Markus: send the top 5 “replication” questions you hear most + any SE must-have disclaimers by Monday EOD PT.
- Soojin: once you add the latency/$ vs tokens/sec slide + PoC talk track section, I’ll re-export the deck + one-pager and re-send to Sales leaders.

For everyone: until the public methodology page is live, please do not forward internal docs externally. Use: “We’ll share the published methodology link as soon as it’s live.”

Thanks,
Stephanie
